description: Defines an AutoMapper mapping profile for converting domain entities to Data Transfer Objects (DTOs) in the PublicApi layer of the eShopOnWeb project.

classes.name: MappingProfile
classes.description: A class inheriting from AutoMapper's Profile, configuring mappings between domain entities and their corresponding DTOs.

methods.name: MappingProfile
methods.description: Constructor that sets up AutoMapper mappings for CatalogItem, CatalogType, and CatalogBrand entities to their DTO counterparts.
